text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Air 
Shakur, a notification came through on her 
device.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I had an online match scheduled for later 
today, but someone dropped out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's a three-person team match. If we're 
down a member, the whole plan goes down 
the drain.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's an amateur running their mouth for? 
Or are you looking down on it just 'cause 
it's a game?
choice_data_list:
If it's you, you can win even with dead 
weight like me tagging along, right?

If it's you, you can win even with one 
dead weight, right?

text_block_list.text:
I told them I was just filling in, and 
that I'd try my best to stay out of the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A handicap race, huh... Not that I mind, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, whatever. But you do exactly as I 
say. Don't go doing anything unnecessary, 
got it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right-click to aim, left-click to attack. 
W-A-S-D to move. Drill the rest of the 
finer controls into your head as you play.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just stay out of our line of fire. 
Alright, let's go—
(Dadadada—!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Yes! One kill. Going smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh crap, I totally forgot about 
Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(When this guy decides not to get in my 
way, his presence completely vanishes. But 
despite that—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. In the end, are you the 
type whose vision gets clouded without the 
stamp of authority?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?
"N-Now, now!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever I'm about to butt heads with 
someone, they butt in without showing the 
slightest bit of fear.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. One just flew past. Left 
click to attack!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Yes! We've won this.

At first I could barely even move, but in 
the end, I managed to score a takedown and 
contribute to the win!
choice_data_list:
Could it be that I'm actually a natural at 
this game...?

Could it be that I'm a natural at this 
game...?

text_block_list.name: Teammate Gamer
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, about that last target. You could've 
taken it yourself, but you let them have 
it, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? Dunno, probably just a 
coincidence..."

text_block_list.name: Teammate Gamer
text_block_list.text:
"Don't try to dodge it. It's rare for you 
to say something like—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's not it at all, dammit.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, it was a lot of fun!

In that case, next time I have to be of 
use...

Just how much practice does it take to get 
that good?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Not like it was a game I even 
particularly wanted to play.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha... You really are an oddball, aren't 
you?

"Even if it was just play, being able to 
experience the same thing as Air Shakur 
felt like a truly precious time."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah, you're a hundred years too early.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The most you're permitted to do is shut 
up and stand there."

Compared to back when they called me 
persistent and annoying, we've gotten a 
little closer... —or at least, that's how 
it felt today!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ain't like I'm doing any special 
trainin' or nothin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I did analyze the program a bit and 
read into the designer's quirks, though."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...What, it's fine, isn't it? I'm not 
doing anything illegal. Just barely on the 
line.

Asking deeper felt a bit scary. It was a 
day that reminded me of how very Air 
Shakur she is—pursuing her interests to 
the absolute limit.
